name: Hatsushiba Chitose
source:
Hobbies: Reading and searching all kinds of romance books
Likes: Spaces where she can be alone
Dislikes: Interacting with other people

[url=/c64279]Haruta's[/url] underclassman who got top results at the entrance exam yet spends most of her time in the school's library instead of going to lessons. Contrary to her beautiful appearance, she gives off an aura that keeps people away from her. She recruits Haruta, whom she's weirdly interested in, to her "Romance Studies Group" where she studies about all kinds of romance in the library.
